description: This Java class 'TopicService' manages Kafka topic names and partition info for different service types and entities within the Thingsboard platform, including notification topics for core, rule engine, transport, edge, and calculated fields, with methods to build and retrieve topic information.

classes.name: TopicService
classes.description: Service class for managing Kafka topic names and partition info for various notification and edge event topics.

methods.name: getNotificationsTopic
methods.description: Returns the TopicPartitionInfo for a given service type and service ID, creating it if absent.

methods.name: buildNotificationsTopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Constructs TopicPartitionInfo for a notification topic with a specific service ID.

methods.name: buildTopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Creates a TopicPartitionInfo object with specified topic, tenant ID, partition, and partition ownership flag.

methods.name: getEdgeNotificationsTopic
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the TopicPartitionInfo for an edge notification topic for a given service ID.

methods.name: buildEdgeNotificationsTopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Builds TopicPartitionInfo for an edge notification topic.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldNotificationsTopic
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the TopicPartitionInfo for calculated field notifications for a given service ID.

methods.name: getEdgeEventNotificationsTopic
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the TopicPartitionInfo for an edge event notification for a specific tenant and edge.

methods.name: buildEdgeEventNotificationsTopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Builds TopicPartitionInfo for an edge event notification.

methods.name: buildTopicName
methods.description: Constructs the full topic name, optionally prefixing with a configured prefix.

methods.name: buildNotificationTopicName
methods.description: Creates a notification topic name by appending service ID.

methods.name: buildConsumerGroupId
methods.description: Builds a consumer group ID string based on service prefix, tenant, queue, and partition.

methods.name: suffix
methods.description: Returns a string suffix for a partition ID, or empty if null.
